newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline up $3 ahead of expected UK duty hike.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline up $3 ahead of expected UK duty hike.

text.p: NWE gasoline rose $3 a tonne on Tuesday on firmer crude oil and some tightness for prompt Rotterdam supply.
By late afternoon talk for physical barges were pegged around $189 fob Rotterdam with July $188.50, August $187.50 and September $185.50.

Dealers said they expected Wednesday's U.K. budget to raise gasoline duty by five percent above inflation or some three to four pence a litre. The U.K. price hike has already been factored into the market but the U.S. gained over 0.5 cent a gallon on Tuesday and helped lift Rotterdam.
